name: Addiction Watch
what: Tracks drug addiction debuff, rehab cost/advice and drug/booster/medical cooldowns via the Torn API.
why: Readable, uses only the Torn API with a Minimal key, display only.

name: Advanced Bounty Filter
what: Adds filters to the bounties page, including a revivable check via the API.
why: Readable, Public key sent only to api.torn.com. Minor bug: the placeholder check compares against a different string, so an unset key still calls the API.

name: Aqua Tools
what: Large multi-module QoL toolkit (chain target list, activity stalker, bazaar quality sort, city finds, company effectiveness, Elo calc, poker calc, stock profit, settings page).
why: Readable and talks only to api.torn.com, but it hooks into the page's network calls on every Torn page and is distributed from GitHub with no visible update date.

name: Arson Bang for Buck
what: Shows profit per nerve and how-to hints for Arson crime targets on the crimes page.
why: Readable, and the only request is one user-triggered call to api.torn.com.

name: Auto Gym Switcher
what: When you press Train, switches to the best gym for that stat first; also shows stat-ratio hints.
why: Replaces your Train request with a different game action (gym change) that you did not click, via a fetch hooking; one request per click but not the action the button shows; last updated Nov 2024.

name: Bazaar Filler
what: Adds Fill/Fill All buttons on the bazaar add/manage pages that fill in price and quantity from market data; the player still submits.
why: Readable, the key only goes to api.torn.com, and it fills form fields without ever submitting a listing.

name: Bazaar Profit Radar
key: Public key, Torn only · needs log access
what: Highlights bazaar listings that are below a trader's buy-price list, for flipping.
why: Clean code that keeps the key on Torn, but it wants a broader key (user log) and targets flipping rather than new players.

name: Better Faction Chat
what: Improves faction chat with member online/travel status dots, rank icons, @mention autocomplete, search and real timestamps.
why: The key only goes to api.torn.com; timers poll the API and redraw the chat only.

name: Bloodbag Reminder
what: Shows a blood-bag icon when life and medical cooldown allow filling blood bags, linking to the armoury or inventory.
why: Readable, no network requests, display-only reminder.

name: Bookie Predictor
what: Bookie match predictor that pulls recommendations from the author's Cloudflare Worker and places bets through a custom button.
why: The settings text says 'Your key... stay in this browser', yet the key is sent in a header on every Worker request. It also places real-money bets with crafted requests.

name: Bootlegging Auto Genre Script
what: Colours Bootlegging genre buttons by shortage and automatically selects the most-needed genre.
why: Automates a game action (auto-selects genre without a click); small but literally against the no-automation rule.

name: Bounty Hunter
what: Filters the global bounty board by reward, FFScouter fair-fight and status, with a med-out watchlist and clickable attack toasts.
why: Sends your player id to the author's personal Cloudflare worker and an FFScouter key to ffscouter.com; readable, no automation.

name: BSP
what: Battle Stats Predictor: shows predicted battle stats for players on profiles, faction lists, attack pages and more, using the author's paid prediction service.
why: Readable and widely used, but it sends your Torn API key to a third-party server (lol-manager.com) on every lookup, and it is a paid subscription service.

name: Burglary Confidence Display
what: Shows the burglary confidence percentage as a coloured number next to the meter.
why: Display only; its a timer only reads an aria-label and redraws text.

name: BUSTR: Torn's Sexiest Bust Reminder
key: Full key, Torn only · needs log access
what: Estimates how many jail busts you can do before the penalty and scores inmates by bust difficulty.
why: Asks for a Full-access key (stored in localStorage) although the code is clean and torn-only.

name: CAT SCRIPT
what: Large faction-war suite: call targets, war roster/hospital timers, battle-stat estimates, loadouts, faction stats; some features paid.
why: Torn key and faction war data go to the author's server (disclosed, Public key), plus optional third-party keys; paid features.

name: Chat Buttons
what: Adds customisable quick-message buttons to chat that fill the text box (with optional {bazaar}/{company}/{faction}/{buy} placeholders); you still press send.
why: API-only and it only fills the chat box; note the key is saved under a generic localStorage name 'apiKey' readable by page scripts.

name: Chat Emoji+
what: Adds an emoji picker (favourites, custom emojis, dark mode) to Torn chat.
why: Local UI only; inserts text into the chat box, never sends.

name: Chat Image Uploader (imgBB)
what: Uploads an image you pick or paste into chat to imgBB and puts the link in the chat box.
why: No Torn data leaves, but pasted images go straight to a public host using a shared embedded key (privacy slip risk, key may get revoked).

name: Chat Link Embedder
what: Auto-embeds images, videos and YouTube links posted in Torn chat.
why: Auto-loading arbitrary links from other players exposes your IP to IP loggers and shows unmoderated media.

name: Chat Lock
what: Long-press the Faction chat button to keep chat open in only one browser tab.
why: No network, cosmetic tab management.

name: Colorblindness Assistance
what: Recolors the energy/nerve/happy/life bars and some global colors for colorblind players.
why: Harmless CSS-only code; Medium only because the last update was March 2025.

name: Colorful Poker
what: Cosmetic theme for Torn poker: button colours and highlights for the active seat and action state.
why: Pure CSS/page styling with no requests.

name: Company Inactivity Highlight
what: Highlights company employees inactive for more than 72 hours on the job list page.
why: Small, readable, API-only.

name: Cracking Prompt Helper
what: Suggests likely passwords for the Cracking crime by matching revealed characters against public password wordlists.
why: Clean code, but last updated June 2024 and Cracking may have changed since.

name: Crime Morale - Scamming Solver
what: Crime 2.0 helper that shows crime morale and gives scamming/pickpocketing suggestions by reading Torn's own crime responses.
why: Readable, makes no requests of its own, and only displays information.

name: Crime Profitability
what: Shows estimated value per nerve on crime pages using a community Google Sheet.
why: Readable and display only; it fetches public spreadsheet data and sends no player data.

name: Crimes 2.0 Hub
what: Offline database of Crimes 2.0 items showing where each item drops and where it is used, with optional market values.
why: Readable code that talks only to api.torn.com for public item prices and never touches game actions.

name: Crimes Rewards Value
what: Shows the market value of item/cash rewards on crime outcomes and a running session total.
why: Readable, one daily Torn API call, display only.

name: Custom & Nearest Torn Events
what: Countdown to the next Torn calendar event in the toolbar, plus optional community 'custom events' you can host or watch.
why: Raw key only goes to api.torn.com; third-party server is opt-in and receives only a SHA-256 hash of the key plus event data.

name: Dark Torn Wiki
what: Dark-mode restyling of wiki.torn.com.
why: Inline style changes only.

name: Descriptive Mission Titles
what: Renames Duke mission titles to describe the objective, filling in target names from the page.
why: Static text replacement on the missions page.

name: Display Crime Chain
key: Limited key, Torn only · needs log access
what: Calculates your current crime chain from the crime log and shows it next to the crimes page heading.
why: Readable and only calls api.torn.com. It hooking window.network calls, but read-only.

name: Disposal Helper
what: Colour-codes Disposal crime methods by risk using Emforus's guide table.
why: 46 lines, no network, styling only.

name: Doobie's Chat Pop Out
what: Adds a button that opens Torn chat in a separate resizable pop-up window.
why: No network code, but it takes over Ctrl+R on every Torn page.

name: Droqs Overseas Stock Reporter
what: Scrapes the foreign shop stock/prices you are looking at while abroad, uploads them to DroqsDB, and shows a travel planner panel.
why: No key or identity sent. It shares public shop stock (YATA-style crowdsourcing) with a third-party site.

name: Execute Perk Tracker
what: Shows enemy HP % and an EXECUTE alert when it drops below your execute-perk threshold on the attack page.
why: No network, display-only alert.

name: Faction Armory UID
what: Appends each weapon and armor item's unique armory ID to its name on the faction armory page.
why: 53-line page-only script.

name: Faction Inactivity Highlight
what: Colours faction member rows by days since their last action and shows the relative last-action time.
why: Benign, but it has not been updated since 2024-01. The key is a hard-coded TornPDA placeholder, so desktop users must paste the key into the source.

name: FairFight in Chat
what: Shows FFScouter fair-fight values next to player names in Torn chat.
why: The key and the IDs of everyone you chat with go to a third-party server. The script is also tiny, anonymous (no @author) and has only 28 installs.

name: Fast Keno
what: Speeds up Keno casino animations 5x.
why: No network; cosmetic timing change.

name: Fast Packs
what: Removes supply-pack opening animations via CSS.
why: CSS-only.

name: Fast Roulette
what: Adds a 'Retry last bet' button and an R hotkey that replay your last roulette bet request without the wheel animation, for grinding the Spinner merit.
why: One click or keypress gives one bet, but it replays a raw game request and makes fast gambling very easy.

name: Fast Slots
what: Speeds up the slot machine reel animation.
why: 35 readable lines with no network. It only speeds up gambling, and was last updated March 2025.

name: FastRevive
what: Adds a 'Fast' button per hospital row that opens the revive prompt, then confirms it if the success chance meets your threshold.
why: No network and one click equals one action.

name: FFScouter Beta
what: Shows estimated Fair Fight / battle-stat estimates for players and faction-war info across Torn pages.
why: Raw Torn API key is sent to ffscouter.com (well-known, disclosed service you sign up for); this is the beta channel.

name: Flight Visualiser
what: Animated world-map view of your current flight (and optionally faction members' flights) with timers and stats.
why: Key only goes to api.torn.com and behaviour is display-only; only caveat is an anonymous StatCounter pixel.

name: FlightClub Helper
what: Adds a plane button on travel items that opens Torn's Send dialog prefilled with a Flight Club collector as recipient and the max quantity.
why: Readable and makes no requests, but it prefills hardcoded recipients with the full quantity, so a careless user could give items away.

name: Forum Favorites
what: Adds stars to pin favourite forum sections to the top of the forum list.
why: Local page reordering with GM storage; no requests.

name: Gym Torn Gain
what: Estimates stat gains per train and for your full energy at the current gym, plus a manual calculator.
why: Code is benign, but it has not been updated since 2024-09 and needs a Limited key. The key sits in page localStorage, only lightly scrambled.

name: GymIQ - Ratio Helper
what: Reads your stats on the gym page and shows ratio targets (Baldr/Hank/custom), 'train next' guidance, history and energy tracking.
why: Page-only display helper with no network requests and no automated clicks.

name: Happy Jump Calculator
what: Gym calculator for happy-jump/booster planning and estimated stat gains.
why: Readable, talks only to api.torn.com, no automation.

name: Hide Crime Outcomes
what: Hides or shrinks the crime outcome panel (or shows it as a toast) so the crime buttons don't shift around.
why: CSS/display only with no requests of its own; last updated about 14 months ago.

name: Hide Leave Faction
what: Removes the Leave Faction button from your own faction page to prevent accidental clicks.
why: Only hides one element with CSS/page removal.

name: HospMe
what: Button to request a paid merc hit (hospitalization) on a target from the Whanau Merc service.
why: Sends the (Public) API key and page URL to a third-party server, disclosed. The use case is paying for attacks on other players.

name: Inventory Sorter
what: Sorts inventory items by market value and shows item values.
why: Unmaintained since 2025-02 and the auto-scroll loader is grey-area; otherwise clean.

name: iOS Tooltip Fix
what: Fixes Torn tooltips that fail to show near screen edges.
why: Tiny CSS-opacity fix, no network.

name: Item Market "Helper"
what: Adds a mug-value calculator to Item Market listings, estimating how much you could mug back from a seller after buying.
why: The full Torn API key goes to the author's own backend (SyncLayer) on each lookup. There is no in-script disclosure or access-level guidance, only a 'Torn API Key' field.

name: Item Market Auto Price
what: When you click an item-market price box, fills in the current lowest listing minus $5, or max quantity.
why: Key goes only to the Torn API, but it is logged to the console and kept in page-readable localStorage. Last updated July 2025.

name: Item Market Favourites Sidebar
what: Adds a reorderable favourite-categories bar to the Item Market.
why: No network, one click equals one native click.

name: Item Stats Helper
what: Shows weapon/armour UIDs on the Items page and copies their stats as JSON to the clipboard for pasting into torn.report.
why: Harmless code, but it has not been updated since 2023-10 and has 14 installs. Its selectors may be broken.

name: Junk Seller
what: Fills price (and quantity/select) fields on Item Market add-listing and bazaar pages from API lowest price, RRP or fixed prices.
why: Auto-pricing that fills the listing form on load is borderline under the no-automation rule, even though the player still submits.

name: Kenny's In-Flight Entertainment
what: Minigames (snake, dino, pong, typing) to play while travelling.
why: No network, no key, pure local UI.

name: Large Chain Timer
what: Makes the faction chain timer much larger.
why: The script itself is 31 harmless lines, but it pulls unpinned code from a gist at install/update and has no maintenance info.

name: Lazy Crimes
what: Adds a 'Lazy' button to Crimes 2.0 that picks the best/recommended option and presses that crime's own button for you.
why: Readable; each press of its button clicks exactly one crime/page button and returns (state machine for multi-step crimes); only external call is a public Google Sheet.

name: Lily's Reviver Tool
what: Hospital-page helper for revivers: filters revivable players and adds a quick revive panel.
why: Grey-area click helpers (moved confirm button, synthetic revive clicks with retries), though it never confirms a revive for the user.

name: Merit Hunter+ QoL for Honors & Medals
what: Shows progress, remaining counts and quick-win suggestions for every honor and medal on the awards page.
why: Readable, talks only to api.torn.com, and makes no page actions.

name: Mission Reward Info
what: On the missions reward shop, shows price ranges for weapon mods, owned ammo, and money-per-credit values.
why: Readable and the key stays with Torn; it does upload anonymous reward-price data to the author's site to crowdsource ranges.

name: Mission Store Weapon Mod Price Evaluator
what: Rates weapon mod prices in the mission credit store as good, medium or bad.
why: Tiny page-only display script.

name: More Legible Player Names
what: Actually named 'Torn Themes': customises Torn's background image, layout width and panel shading via CSS.
why: Pure CSS/theme script with local settings; no requests or actions.

name: Nuke REVIVE ME
what: Adds a 'Revive Me' link that sends a revive request to the Nuke faction's revive service when you are in hospital.
why: Sends player id/name to a third-party server (expected for a revive service) and updates straight from a GitHub repo with no Greasy Fork review.

name: OC Payout Filter
what: Adds a toggle to hide completed organized crimes that have already been paid out on the faction crimes tab.
why: Pure page filter with no network code.

name: OC Weights Under Roles
what: Shows each Organized Crime role's weight (importance %) from tornprobability.com under the role.
why: Only fetches public weight data; no key or player data sent.

name: OpenMarket
what: Shows quality and bonus percentages on Item Market, Auction House and Bazaar listings.
why: No network or key, display only, compliance addressed by the author.

name: OpsCheck Checklist Manager
what: Floating multi-checklist panel whose items can link to Torn pages and be ticked off.
why: No network code at all; it only stores checklists in localStorage and navigates on the player's click.

name: OutcomeDB
what: Crowd-sources crime outcome research data by capturing every crime attempt's result and uploading it.
why: Silently sends game data from every crime attempt to a third-party server, and gives the user nothing back.

name: Pickpocketing Target Filter
what: Highlights pickpocketing targets by type and timing, greys out/disables unwanted ones, and plays optional sound alerts.
why: Display and sound only; it only disables (never clicks) buttons and only runs while the tab has focus.

name: Poker Bet Slider
what: Adds a slider to the poker table that sets the bet amount input.
why: No network, no action automation.

name: Poker Card Highlight
what: Colours your hole/board cards by hand strength and shows preflop range hints on the Hold'em table.
why: Display-only overlay with no network code and no clicks on game buttons.

name: Portapotty
what: Adds a Quick Search button on the dump page that runs a search without the animation.
why: One click sends one search request that the normal Search button would send; about 18 months without updates, so it may break.

name: Prayer Reminder
what: Adds a church icon to the status bar until you pray that UTC day.
why: Local reminder link only; just listens for your own Pray click.

name: QOL: Item Intel
what: Adds markers and tooltips to item icons showing OC use, enhancer effects, crime requirements and energy/nerve/happy gains.
why: Readable, all data hardcoded, no network, display only.

name: QOL: Med Advisor
what: Recommends which/how many medical items to use based on your HP and hospital time.
why: Grey-area use of a Torn internal endpoint instead of the API, with an automatic retry.

name: Quick DVD
what: Adds a link on the Bootlegging crime that copies a DVD of the next or least-stocked genre.
why: Forges crime requests (grey). It is unversioned on a gist with no update data, and its loader.php match and hashed class names likely no longer fit the current crimes page.

name: Racing Commentary
what: Adds a live text-commentary overlay to the racing page, built from the race page plus optional Torn API racing data.
why: Clean API use, but it fires an undisclosed statcounter tracking pixel every time you open the racing page.

name: Rem4k's Item Locking Script
what: Lets you padlock inventory items so they are hidden on trade, bazaar, market-listing, shop-sell and faction donate pages to prevent accidental selling.
why: No network; note it removes Torn's native lock icons and select-all box on the Item Market and only hides items visually.

name: Rem4rk's Item Wiki Links
what: Adds a small W link on item images that opens the item's Torn wiki page.
why: 114 readable lines, no network, just adds links.

name: Remaining Time on Tab Title
what: Shows the travel, hospital, racing or chain countdown in the browser tab title.
why: Tiny, readable and display only. Last updated April 2025 and relies on hashed class names that may have gone stale.

name: Russian Roulette AIO Tool
key: Limited key, Torn only · needs log access
what: Russian Roulette tracker with win/loss stats, a profit graph, Martingale bet calculator, and custom buttons that start games and shoot.
why: Places gambling actions through hand-built sends (one per click), pushes Martingale betting, and its optional 'Instant Leave' redirects the page automatically after each game.

name: RW Gear Price Checker
what: Looks up historical auction sale prices and current market/bazaar listings for ranked-war weapons and armour with matching bonuses.
why: It only fetches public price data from the author's Supabase backend and TornW3B. No key or identity leaves the browser.

name: Search for Cash Suggester
what: Highlights the suggested Search for Cash location on the crimes page based on percentages and time-of-day heuristics.
why: Only adds a highlight/badge; no clicks or requests (though its jittered scan timer and 'torn-auto-tools' namespace look borrowed from an auto-clicker).

name: Search Torn Forums by User
what: Adds a poster/user field (using Torn's native autocomplete) to forum search.
why: No network or key, simple UI helper.

name: Shoplifting Monitor
what: Polls shoplifting security status and alerts (sound/visual/optional Discord ping) when cameras or guards are down at chosen shops.
why: Key goes only to api.torn.com, and the Discord webhook is opt-in, user-owned and carries no key. It runs on every torn.com page, so several open tabs multiply API calls.

name: Show Bazaar Listings in Market
what: Shows cheaper player bazaar listings (from TornW3B) inside the Item Market and syncs auction-house listings you view to weav3r.dev.
why: No key is sent, but it auto-uploads other players' auction data (IDs/names/bids) to a third-party server. That upload is disclosed in @description and the host is the well-known TornW3B.

name: Show War Local Time
what: Shows territory and ranked war end times in your local time on the faction page.
why: Harmless display code, but unmaintained since January 2024 and its ranked-war math hardcodes a 123h duration.

name: Smart Stock Vault
key: Full key, Torn only · needs log access
what: Stock-market dashboard that tracks a 'vault' portfolio, P&L, blocks and swing trades, and places buy/sell orders from its own panels.
why: Needs a Full Access key and places trades with its own crafted sends; the live paths do one trade per click, but uncalled multi-trade loop functions (executeSpreadTrades/executeRebalance/executeWithdrawPlan) are still in the code.

name: Solenya's Merits Tracker
what: Panel listing your missing honors/merits, easiest first, with how-to guides per honor.
why: Readable, sends the key only to api.torn.com, display-only.

name: Spotlight Search
what: Ctrl+Shift+K command palette to jump to Torn pages and custom bookmarks.
why: Harmless code, but unmaintained since 2024-09 and depends on two unreviewed @require libraries.

name: Stock Cash Buy/Sell
what: Adds a cash-amount box to stock buy/sell so you can type dollars instead of share counts.
why: No network; only pre-fills an input the player must confirm.

name: Stock Manager & Advisor
what: Stock-market 'vault' panel: one-click buy/sell of a chosen stock to park cash, plus portfolio P/L, benefit-block protection and an ROI advisor.
why: Moves real in-game money through hand-built sends to Torn's trade endpoint (grey under the rules); otherwise readable, and the key is only sent to api.torn.com.

name: Supply Pack Analyzer
what: Tracks supply pack purchases/openings from your logs and computes profit and drop rates.
why: Needs a Full-access key (stored in localStorage) and sends your player id to the author's worker.

name: Swiss Army Knife
what: Bundle of small QoL modules (weapon tab on right, faction balance, company filter, chat highlighter, hospital timer, RR filter, chain bonus highlighter).
why: Readable, API-only, display features; low install count.

name: TCAT - Torn Chain Alerter and Tools
what: Chain timer alerts (tab title/sound), optional Discord webhook alerts, and a chain target list tool with faction import and sorting.
why: Readable, key only goes to api.torn.com, and the webhook goes to the user's own Discord.

name: TEEM - Torn's Elephant Economy Manager
what: Market signals, travel-profit rankings, war-gear pricing and crime $/hour tracker panel.
why: Readable, key only goes to api.torn.com, YATA calls are public data; hosted on GitHub (not Greasy Fork) so no install/review metadata.

name: TimeZoneTracker
what: Shows clocks for chosen time zones in the Torn footer.
why: No network or key; pure display.

name: Torn City Weather Forecast
what: Novelty 7-day 'Torn City' weather widget on profile pages using real forecast data.
why: Harmless function, but it includes an undisclosed StatCounter tracking pixel that reports each profile-page view to a third party.

name: Torn Color Customizer
what: Recolors sidebar notification highlights and ranked-war weapon/armor rarity backgrounds.
why: Cosmetic CSS changes stored in localStorage, no network.

name: Torn Crack
what: Suggests candidate passwords for the Cracking crime from a 1M wordlist plus a community word list.
why: Sends in-game page data to an unlisted personal Cloudflare worker (wildcard *.workers.dev @connect) and does one unprompted page reload.

name: Torn Foreign Stock
what: Shows live abroad shop stock, restock countdowns and travel profit per item on the travel page.
why: The key goes only to api.torn.com, and the third-party calls are anonymous fetches of public stock data.

name: Torn Forum Notifier
what: Polls the Torn API for new posts in the player's own and subscribed forum threads and shows notifications.
why: Readable and uses only the Torn API, but it is very new with about 7 installs.

name: Torn Forums Feed Height Increase
what: Makes forum feed panels taller.
why: Rated Medium only because it is unmaintained since 2024-05; the code is one harmless CSS line (worst case it stops working).

name: Torn Mail Templates
what: Saves and loads mail subject/body templates, adds a Quick Send button with a 10s cooldown, and adds mail buttons to the user list.
why: No network and one click equals one send. It is installed from GitHub raw rather than Greasy Fork, and it auto-updates from there.

name: Torn Newspaper Ad Blocker
what: Hides the player-ad message strip on newspaper, job list, bounties and similar pages.
why: The 53-line CSS hide is harmless, but it has not been updated since 2024-03 and may no longer match Torn's hashed class names.

name: Torn Poker HUD & Coach
what: Profiles poker opponents (VPIP/PFR etc.) from the hand log on the holdem page and shows badges plus live coaching hints.
why: Readable, key only goes to api.torn.com, and the GitHub sync is opt-in to the user's own private gist. 23.5k lines were grep-audited, not read line by line.

name: Torn Quick-Nav Hotkeys
what: Configurable keyboard shortcuts that open Torn pages.
why: No network, no key, navigation only.

name: Torn Racing Guide
what: Racing overlay with best cars and parts per track, highlighting recommended upgrades.
why: No network, no key, display only.

name: Torn Radial Menu
what: Radial quick-navigation menu with search, notes, timers and an optional API bars/money monitor.
why: Readable, only talks to api.torn.com, clicks are navigation/UI links and file export.

name: Torn Spy - Bazaar
what: Integrates the tornspy.com spy-report marketplace into Torn: stats on profiles and faction pages, buying reports, using company spy specials.
why: A third-party server controls HTML injected into Torn pages and supplies the recipient and amount for cash sent via sendcash.php. The script also uploads browsing and attack data.

name: Torn Stats Comparison - TSC
what: Button on profiles that compares a few of your personal stats against the viewed player.
why: Small, readable, API-only on explicit click.

name: Torn Tactical Clock
what: Draggable floating widget showing TCT and local time.
why: Pure display with no requests.

name: Torn Themes
what: Customizes Torn's background image, layout width and panel shading.
why: Cosmetic CSS only, no requests or key.

name: Torn War Stuff Enhanced
what: On the faction war page, shows travel status and hospital countdowns for enemy members and sorts them by hospital time.
why: Every poll uploads faction API data and a key-derived hash to twse.dev, which the script description does not mention.

name: Torn-Per-Day
what: Adds a per-day rate comparison graph under the personal stats charts.
why: Display-only, no network, uses only data already on the page.

name: TornBuddy - Chat Enhancer
what: Saves favourite contacts and fills their ID into the recipient box on messages, trade and item-send pages.
why: Only fills a text input from localStorage and never sends anything.

name: TornCast
what: Raycast-style keyboard launcher for jumping to Torn pages, plus a small calculator.
why: Navigation shortcuts only; the calculator uses its own parser, not eval.

name: Trade Reputation
what: Shows and lets you vote on crowd-sourced trader reputation on profiles, plus Torn Exchange data and mug/trade evidence.
why: Sends the raw Torn API key to a personal workers.dev server while its key prompt says the key is 'stored locally in your browser only', and auto-uploads your Events page contents.

name: Trading Companion Script
what: Values items in a trade using the trader's weav3r.dev pricelist, shows receipts and helps add money/accept trades.
why: Asks for a Full-access key and sends player id/name and trade contents to weav3r.dev (well-known trader site).

name: Travel Agency 3.0D
what: Replaces the travel page's world map with an interactive 3D globe.
why: Cosmetic, readable, no network beyond pinned CDN libraries and static images.

name: Travel Blocker
what: Warns about or blocks the travel page's fly buttons when an OC is about to start, a drug cooldown or war is active, etc.
why: Readable, talks only to api.torn.com, and is purely a safety/blocking aid.

name: Unf**k Torn
what: Replaces Torn's censored swear words in forum posts with the original words.
why: Text replacement only with no network code.

name: Universal Healthcare
what: Adds a REVIVE ME button while in hospital that sends a revive request to the Universal Healthcare Alliance.
why: Sends player ID, name and faction to a third-party server, though only public identity data, only on an explicit click, and that is the point of the script.

name: View Listings Anytime
key: Full key, Torn only · needs log access
what: Shows your bazaar, item market and points market listings (and prices) even when those pages are unavailable, e.g. while in hospital/travelling.
why: Readable and API-only, but explicitly asks for a Full access key (log selection) stored in page localStorage, and prompts for it on every Torn page until set.

name: War Stuff Enhanced Beta
what: On faction war pages, shows travel/hospital timers, sorts members by status, and adds a chain-timer bubble and copy buttons.
why: Shares faction member status data with twse.dev by default; this is explained in the settings, but it is a beta build.

name: WarBuddy
what: Faction war roster monitor with member status, hospital timers and bounty info on the faction page.
why: Public key used only against api.torn.com; no third-party hosts or automation.
